Bloomberg.s: Veteran oil trader Jonathan Zarembok is joining Dangote Group, which has a huge refinery in Nigeria and is expanding elsewhere in Africa, according to people familiar with the matter.

Bloomberg.s: Deutsche Bank AG’s Binky Chadha is among the most bullish stock forecasters on Wall Street, predicting the S&P 500 will recover from its rout to rally 25% by the end of next year.

Bloomberg.t: Aareal Bank Nears Commercial Real Estate SRT With 12% Premium
Bloomberg.s: Aareal Bank AG is set to pay investors a premium of more than 12% to hedge part of the risk on a commercial real estate lending book worth around €2.5 billion ($2.7 billion) in only its second such deal.

Bloomberg.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 25
Bloomberg.s: Oil swung between gains and losses as traders weighed escalating attacks in the Middle East against increasing crude supply.

Bloomberg.s: The Australian dollar is poised for its biggest monthly slide in more than 13 years as it extended losses on Wednesday, with the weakness in global stocks damping demand for currencies linked to growth.
